narrative: OMX30 enters Friday in a strong bull trend (+8.5% above 200-MA, ADX 53.9) supported by US equity gains and robust technical momentum (MACD bullish, ROC-90 +13.5%). However, RSI 76.53 flashes overbought warning and the index sits 94% into its 52-week range, only 1.4% from highs — room for mean reversion pullback is limited. Oil's +1.02% rise provides tailwind for industrials, while gold and stable FX support miners and exporters. Expect modest upside bias (+0.3 to +0.5%) but watch for profit-taking on overbought conditions; US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) could inject volatility.
morningBrief: Open short: OMX30 likely consolidates higher but lacks conviction above 3180 (50-MA/resistance). Technicals remain bullish—MACD above signal, strong ADX—but RSI 76.53 is a yellow flag for pullback risk into support around 3085 (lower Bollinger band). Industrials (28% weight) get modest lift from oil +1%; banks catch gentle bid from steady rates. Watch for profit-taking after Thursday's rally. Key watch: US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET; softer data could extend risk rally, but hard data could trigger rotation. Exporters (Volvo, Atlas Copco, Ericsson) slightly favored by USD/SEK stability; avoid aggressively chasing at these highs.
